Rock Hill Bicycle Club Women's Wednesday Ride

Rock Hill, SC · Downtown · Road

Women / trans / femmeNo-dropBeginner friendly

Rock Hill Bicycle Club Women's Wednesday Ride is a road group ride in Rock Hill, SC. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:30 pm from Wells Fargo parking lot. About 20–25 miles, single group, 14–17 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @RockHillBikeClub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rock Hill Bicycle Club Women's Wednesday Ride group ride

A women-only road ride from downtown Rock Hill. One group, social pace, nobody dropped. It is meant for learning group riding, from new riders to seasoned ones. Distance depends on daylight.
